title: Where to Start with AI in Your Business
content:
Your business does NOT need a chatbot.
You need one boring task, automated properly.

A lot of owners hear "AI" and put a chatbot on their website.
Then nobody uses it.
And then they decide that AI doesn't work.
The problem is not AI. The problem is the starting point.

So here is a four-step way to start.

Step ONE. Find the repeat.
For one week, write down every task your team does the same way, every single day.
Same questions. Same copy-paste. Same follow-up messages.
Note how often it happens, and how many minutes it takes each time.

Step TWO. Pick just ONE task.
Choose the one with clear rules, where a mistake is small and easy to fix.
Imagine a clinic where the front desk gets the same questions all day.
What are your hours? What are the fees? How do I book an appointment?
That is a perfect first task.

But here is the real twist.
Most people skip the next step.

Step THREE. Keep a human in the loop.
The AI writes the draft. Your staff approves it.
For the first month, do not let the AI talk to customers on its own.
This is how you build trust, inside your team and with your customers.

Step FOUR. Measure it.
How long did the task take before? How long does it take now?
If you can't see the difference in numbers, be honest. That task was the wrong pick.
Then pick the next one and try again.
Without numbers, an AI project is just an opinion.
With numbers, it becomes a business decision.

From a builder's point of view, the best AI project often looks boring.
No fancy demo. Just hours saved and fewer mistakes.
Once the first task works, the second and third get much easier.
And your team stops being afraid of AI, and starts using it.
Start small. But start every day.
